title: Add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs site updates
author: Ava Thompson
description: Context: Add a set of RAG agent quickstarts (tool-calling patterns) to our examples repository and wire up a docs site tutorial. Motivation: customers frequently ask for concrete agent examples that show tool invocation patterns (search, retrieval, API calls) alongside RAG templates and prompt/response handling. These quickstarts are intended to be lightweight, opinionated reference implementations that ship with tests and a docs tutorial. Summary of changes: - New examples under examples/rag-agent/{python,typescript,templates} showing end-to-end tool-calling flows (retriever -> agent -> tool -> response). - Docs site updates: new guide at docs/guides/rag-agent-tool-calling.md and navigation entry. - Add examples smoke tests and minimal CI steps so examples stay runnable. - Small lint/test fixes surfaced by CI. Checklist: - [x] Add Python quickstart and tests - [x] Add TypeScript quickstart and tests - [x] Add reusable RAG templates and agent skeletons - [x] Add docs site page and nav item - [x] Add CI smoke test for examples - [x] Address reviewer feedback and lint issues Notes: The docs page includes a short walkthrough and copy-paste-ready snippets. The examples are intentionally small (single-file quickstarts) and reference our SDK helpers. Where appropriate the examples point to the full reference implementation in redwood-examples/rag-agent-playbooks for more advanced patterns. Related: ENG-4521, previous work in pr-28350 and pr-28678 (RAG quickstart series).
